notes.title: The Network Expansion and Racing Mayhem Analysis Log Starts NOW 🏎️💨
notes.content:
Hello lasagna lovers 🍝

It is time!

[h3]Let your engines roar! The Network Expansion and Racing Mayhem Analysis Log (or N.E.R.M.A.L.) Is Now Live![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636063/02e53418fd298ceee71403f24e20f2d3d53ff2e3.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]How can I participate?[/h3]
Simple!
[list][*]Go to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239650/Garfield_Kart_2__All_You_Can_Drift/]Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift’s Steam page[/url][/b]
[*][b]Hit “Request Access”[/b] on the game page to join [b]Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift - Network Expansion and Racing Mayhem Analysis Log[/b]
[*][b]Download the Demo[/b]
[*]Once installed, [b]access it from your Steam Library[/b][/list]

[h3]What can I expect to find?[/h3]
[list][*][b]3 Characters[/b], representing each a weight category: [b]Garfield[/b] (obviously, it’s his game after all), [b]Nermal[/b] (we suspect he was involved with naming this program, but we haven’t found any conclusive evidence so far) and [b]Liz[/b] (we needed someone somewhat responsible to keep the others in check)
[*][b]2 Tracks - Western Spaghetti & Plate Runner[/b]
[*][b]1 Kart[/b] with its customization options
[*][b]Online Mode[/b][/list]
[h3]Ready to race against a real heavyweight?[/h3]

[h3]🐈🏎️ Add Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift to your wishlist now![/h3]
